title: Numbered classic scripts in one global scope, no build step, hosted on GitHub Pages
context: index.html loads 00- to 99- scripts in order; each may only use names from same- or lower-numbered files (tests/loadorder.js). The worker importScripts 10/11/12. tools/build-single.js makes a one-file preview. Same layout as F13LD.mesh, lab and sweep.
